theater: 帕倫基城邦與烏蘇馬辛塔河谷

battle.name: 第六次「星際大戰」
battle.theater: 帕倫基城邦與烏蘇馬辛塔河谷
battle.brief: 公元672年6月29日，帕倫基在瑪雅長紀曆9.12.0.0.0這個時期終結日發動星戰，擊敗一個銘文未具名的政權，是帕倫基唯一可考的星際大戰。出征日由王室祭司依金星曆算定，國王巴卡爾統兵。卡面的羅馬重步兵未現於中美洲；與其相當的是瑪雅棉甲圓盾結成的正面。

kit.name: 羅馬重步兵
kit.history: 分段鎧甲配重盾。羅馬的戰力靠的是補充兵源與補給線，不是靠重裝。

countries: 這場戰爭是瑪雅古典期低地城邦之間的一次決定性衝突，交戰雙方都是獨立的城邦政治體，沒有宣戰程序，也沒有常備國軍。勝方是帕倫基城邦：以帕倫基王室的石柱、神廟與宮殿為核心，王位由王族血脈擔任，祭祀與曆算由王室祭司集團掌握，兵員從王畿村落的菁英與民兵中抽調，並沒有獨立的國防編制。敗方在現存銘文中完全沒有留下名字，只能確定是位於帕倫基勢力圈邊緣的一個第三方政權：它有自己的君主、自己的菁英突擊隊與城防，同樣靠城邦抽調的民兵作戰，沒有任何可考的兵員編組紀錄。這一空白本身就說明瑪雅戰爭的性質——勝敗不是國家對國家，而是城邦聯盟體系內的強弱消長。同一年在低地另一端還有另一條戰線：多斯皮拉斯在670年打敗蒂卡爾，蒂卡爾則在672年12月反攻奪回多斯皮拉斯，卡爾卡穆爾自幕後扶持多斯皮拉斯。帕倫基的星戰是在這張多國棋盤上打的；它的對手雖小，意義卻不低，因為星勝一方往往就此更替王朝、建立宗主權，甚至扶植舊王朝復國。
countriesEn: This war was a decisive clash between city-states of the Classic Maya lowlands, in a world without declarations of war and without standing national armies. The victor was the city-state of Palenque: its core was the stelae, temples and palace of the royal house, kingship was held by a royal lineage, the calendrical and ritual business was run by a priestly corps attached to the court, and the troops were drawn from the elite and the militia of the villages around the capital, with no separate national establishment at all. The defeated side left no name anywhere in the surviving inscriptions; all that can be established is that it was a third polity on the fringe of Palenque's sphere of influence, with its own ruler, its own elite strike force and its own defences, fought in the same way by a militia levied from its own villages, and with no recoverable record of its order of battle. That absence is itself informative: in the Maya world a war of this kind was not a clash between states but a shift in the balance of power inside a web of city-states. On the far side of the lowlands the same year saw a different front: Dos Pilas had defeated Tikal in 670, Tikal retook Dos Pilas in December 672, and Calakmul stood behind Dos Pilas throughout. Palenque's star war was fought on that crowded board, and although its opponent was small the stakes were not, since a star-war victory regularly meant a new dynasty installed, a new suzerainty established, or an extinguished house restored to its throne.
people: 可點名的人主要來自帕倫基一側。國王 K'inich Janaab' Pakal（巴卡爾）自615年即位到683年去世，本役的出征令出自他；瑪雅的王權與戰爭從來不分家，國王主持祭祀、頒布儀式，戰首（og）帶兵，王后與王室血親則是盟邦與附庸網絡的樞紐。真正決定本役時日的是王室的祭司兼天文官：星戰的日期不是隨意挑的，必須落在曆法與星象都站得住的節點上，9.12.0.0.0 這樣一個 0.0.0 的時期終結日正是最典型的目標，祭司要先算出金星（瑪雅語 Chak Ek'，大星）的相位與節氣，才能宣告出征。帶兵的是城邦的菁英將領與佩槍隊的隊長，隨軍的還有抄寫戰果的書記、負責談判俘虜贖回的中人、搬運糧秣的勞役隊，以及記錄血池與頭堆的祭司書吏。對面的君主與首領沒有留下名字，這是這場戰爭最扎眼的一處空白。背景人物則可以點名：蒂卡爾的國王 Nuun Ujol Chaak（努恩·烏卓爾·查克）在同一年攻取多斯皮拉斯，把巴萊赫·錢·卡維爾逐入五年流亡；多斯皮拉斯的國王 Balaj Chan K'awiil（巴萊赫·錢·卡維爾）於677年復位，並在679年反敗為勝；卡爾卡穆爾的強人 Yuknoom Ch'een II（尤克努姆·切恩二世）是這盤棋背後的手。同一系列的星戰還留下一條後續：711年，托尼納在星戰中擊敗帕倫基。
peopleEn: Most of the names we can give come from Palenque's side. The king, K'inich Janaab' Pakal (Pakal), reigned from 615 until his death in 683, and the order to march issued from him; in the Maya world kingship and warfare were never separate, for the king conducted the rituals and proclaimed the ceremonies while the war chiefs (og) led the soldiers, and the queen together with the royal kindred formed the hinge of the alliance and vassal network. What actually fixed the date of this campaign was the court's priest-astronomers: the day of a star war was never chosen at will, it had to fall on a node in the calendar and in the stars, and a period-ending date of the 0.0.0 kind such as 9.12.0.0.0 was exactly the kind of target that suited this, for the priests first had to compute the phase of Venus (Chak Ek', the Great Star) and the season before the departure could be proclaimed. The troops were led by the city's elite commanders and by the captains of the spearmen, accompanied by scribes who wrote down the results, mediators who negotiated ransoms, porters who moved the food, and by the priestly recorders of pools of blood and piles of heads. The enemy ruler and his captains left no name behind, and that blank is the most glaring gap in the story. The players in the background can be named: Tikal's king Nuun Ujol Chaak attacked and captured Dos Pilas in the same year, driving Balaj Chan K'awiil into a five-year exile; Balaj Chan K'awiil was restored in 677 and turned the tables in 679; and the strong man of Calakmul, Yuknoom Ch'een II, was the hand behind the board. The same series of star wars also leaves a later trace: in 711 Tonina defeated Palenque in a star war.
kits: 卡面上這件羅馬重步兵（Legionary，約公元前100年）從未出現在中美洲。分段鎧甲配大弧形重盾的羅馬重步兵，靠的是盾牆式的正面、長矛與投射器的密度，以及後方不斷補上的兵源與糧道，這些都與瑪雅戰場無關。放到本役，與它功能相當的是瑪雅城邦的佩槍菁英：長矛配棉甲與圓盾結成的正面。瑪雅的裝備可分五層。第一層是近戰：木柄上鑲黑曜石或燧石刃的黑曜石木劍（macuahuitl），須雙手揮砍；石斧、木棍；以及矛尖為石、骨或黑曜石的長矛。第二層是投射：擲矛器（atlatl）配加重前端的細長木矛，是最普遍的投射武器；短弓與箭；石彈投石索。第三層是防護：菁英穿以棉絮或毛絮填充的夾層棉甲（ichcahuipilli），外罩獸皮，配木框蒙獸皮綴羽的圓盾（chictli），頭戴硬木或獸皮頭套，重要人物另有護肩與神像面具。第四層是儀器與天文器：黑曜石偏心形石鏃（eccentric）作成神像與獸首，祭司以之配曆，記錄本役的銘文正是繫在 9.12.0.0.0 這個節點上。第五層是攻城與後勤：木梯、繩索、破門用的斧與火攻草束，建築多為木構茅頂，一經點燃難以撲救；瑪雅沒有馭獸，糧秣、矛束、繩梯全靠人背，渡河改用獨木舟，主食是玉米、豆類與鹹魚。羅馬重步兵那句戰力靠補充兵源與補給線的話，反倒在瑪雅城邦的常備制度裡找不到任何對應物。
kitsEn: The card shows a Roman legionary (Legionary, c. 100 BC) that never existed in Mesoamerica. The segmented armour and the large curved scutum of a legionary relied on a wall-like front, on the density of spears and missiles, and above all on a steady flow of replacements and supply behind the line; none of that had any bearing on a Maya battlefield. The functional counterpart here is the Maya elite spearman: a front built of long spears, padded cotton armour and round shields. Maya equipment can be sorted into five layers. First, close combat: the obsidian- or flint-bladed wooden sword (macuahuitl), which had to be swung with two hands; stone axes and clubs; and long spears with stone, bone or obsidian points. Second, missile weapons: the atlatl thrower with weighted light spears, by far the most common; short bows and arrows; and stone-tipped slings. Third, protection: elites wore quilted cotton armour (ichcahuipilli) stuffed with cotton or wool, covered with animal hide, together with a round shield (chictli) of wooden frame faced with hide and feathered, and hardwood or hide headgear, while notables added shoulder guards and deity masks. Fourth, instruments of ritual and astronomy: eccentric obsidian flints shaped as deities and animal heads, which the priests matched to the calendar; the inscription that records this campaign is tied precisely to the node 9.12.0.0.0. Fifth, siege and logistics: wooden ladders, ropes, axes for breaking doors and fire bundles, since most buildings were wooden with thatched roofs and once ignited were hard to put out; there were no draft animals, for food, spear bundles and rope ladders all went on human backs, rivers were crossed by canoe, and the staple diet was maize, beans and salted fish. The line about a legionary's strength lying in replacements and supply lines has no counterpart whatever in the civic military system of a Maya city-state.
tactics: 星戰有一套固定的程序。第一步是定日：祭司兼天文官依金星表與260日曆，算出符合時機的出征日，國王隨即以儀式宣布，之後才是集兵與開拔；銘文裡的星字形象是星辰把液滴灑向大地，正說明戰爭被當成一件受神權裁決的事。第二步是行軍：隊伍由菁英佩槍隊開路，後隨擲矛手、弓手與投石手，糧食由勞役隊背負，渡水靠獨木舟；沒有騎兵，遠征速度取決於河道與雨季泥濘。第三步是接戰：圓盾相接結成正面，長矛從盾縫刺出，擲矛手在散兵線上反覆投射逼近，弓手壓制對方射手；真正造成大量殺傷的是嵌黑曜石刃的木劍，砍完還得把兵器拔出來。第四步是破城與收尾：突擊多靠夜襲與火攻而非長期圍城，城破之後是獻祭與羞辱俘虜，割喉、取血、剖心，首級堆成堆，最後立碑記功。有一點值得注意：多數星戰集中在十一月到翌年一月的乾季，收穫期（九月中至十月下旬）一場都沒有；本役定在六月二十九日，正落在雨季，是相對少見的例外，道路泥濘、河水漲水，既拖慢遠征，也讓獨木舟運糧更為順手。
tacticsEn: Star wars followed a fixed procedure. The first step was fixing the date: priest-astronomers worked from the Venus tables and the 260-day calendar to calculate a departure day that would be auspicious, the king then announced it by rite, and only after that were the troops mustered and the columns set out; the star glyph, showing a star spilling droplets over the earth, expresses the idea that the war was adjudicated by divine authority. The second step was the march: elite spearmen led the column, with atlatl throwers, archers and slingers behind them, food carried by porters, rivers crossed by canoe; there was no cavalry, and the speed of a distant campaign was set by the rivers and by the mud of the rainy season. The third step was the clash: round shields locked together into a front, spears thrust through the gaps, atlatl throwers worked the loose line and kept hurling, archers suppressed the enemy archers; the real slaughter came from the obsidian-bladed wooden sword, which had to be pulled free before it could be used again. The fourth step was storming the town and the aftermath: surprise attacks and fire did most of the work rather than long siege, and once the walls were down came sacrifice and humiliation of captives, throat-cutting, bloodletting and heart-opening, heads piled up, and finally a stela to record the deed. One point deserves emphasis: most star wars cluster in the dry season from November to January, and not one is recorded during the harvest season, from mid-September to late October; this campaign, fixed on 29 June, falls in the rainy season and is a relative exception, with muddy roads and swollen rivers that slowed the march but made canoe transport of grain easier.
data: 本役的日期是這批記錄裡最硬的一條：公元672年6月29日，瑪雅長紀曆 9.12.0.0.0；0.0.0 的部分表示這是一個卡敦（katun）時期的終結日，每7200天一遇，是重大曆法標記。整批星戰銘文共記13場，橫跨562至781年；其中七成的星戰日期對應金星的昏星相位，而在這七成之中又有八成四對應昏星初現。季節分布上，11月至翌年1月的乾季最密集，9月中至10月下旬的收穫期完全沒有記錄；另有研究指出部分星戰緊接日蝕之後，與火星、木星、土星的逆行期也見重合。失利方的代價有具體事例：562年卡拉科爾在星戰中擊敗蒂卡爾，蒂卡爾此後約120年停止立碑，人口下降，大廣場部分紀念建築被毀；631年卡爾卡穆爾擊敗納蘭霍，其君主被凌虐致死，甚至可能被吃掉；669年托爾圖格羅的碑銘寫下血積成池、頭顱堆成堆；679年多斯皮拉斯擊敗蒂卡爾，銘文同樣記下血池與頭堆。本役的敵方因為未具名，沒有留下任何可比的傷亡與俘虜數字——這不是遺漏，而是當時的記錄方式：勝方只記自己的功業。
dataEn: The hardest single fact about this campaign is its date: 29 June 672 AD, Maya Long Count 9.12.0.0.0; the 0.0.0 part shows this to be a katun-ending date, one that comes round every 7200 days, and so a major calendrical marker. The whole corpus of star-war inscriptions records thirteen campaigns spread across 562 to 781; seventy percent of their dates correspond to the evening phase of Venus, and eighty-four percent of those correspond to the first appearance of the evening star. As for season, the dry season from November to January is the densest, and there is not a single one in the harvest season from mid-September to late October; some studies also note campaigns falling shortly after solar eclipses, and overlaps with the retrograde periods of Mars, Jupiter and Saturn. The cost of defeat has documented cases: in 562 Caracol beat Tikal in a star war, and Tikal then ceased erecting monuments for roughly 120 years, its population fell and part of the Great Plaza was destroyed; in 631 Calakmul defeated Naranjo and its ruler was tortured to death, possibly eaten; the Tortuguero inscription of 669 reads that the blood was pooled and the skulls were piled; and in 679 Dos Pilas defeated Tikal, with the inscriptions again recording pools of blood and piles of heads. Our defeated opponent, being unnamed, leaves behind no comparable figures for casualties or prisoners - not an omission but a feature of how such things were recorded: the victor wrote down only his own achievement.
cause: 瑪雅城邦之間沒有宣戰程序，星戰的起因通常寫在神權與政治兩層。第一層是時間：星戰要挑在曆法與星象都站得住的日子，9.12.0.0.0 這樣的時期終結日意味著誰能率先完成禮儀，誰就等於在時序上佔了上風，這是可以在城邦之間公開較量的合法性。第二層是現實：偏居西南隅的帕倫基在蒂卡爾與卡爾卡穆爾兩強的夾縫裡生存，烏蘇馬辛塔河谷沿線的交通、水源與貿易節點都要靠武力維持，附庸與盟邦也需要靠一次成功的星戰重新確認秩序；對手則多半是這一帶規模較小的政權，它企圖挑戰帕倫基的權威，或者趁帕倫基主力遠離時奪取其邊緣的資源地。史料殘缺，敵方城名、爭執的具體地點與導火索都沒有留下；可以確定的只有：這是一場由王朝權威與祭祀義務驅動、並被天文曆法定時的城邦決鬥，而不是可以簡化成一句話的私人恩怨。同一年，蒂卡爾與多斯皮拉斯也在同一條低地賽道上互相攻伐，提醒我們這幾年整個區域的權力格局正在劇烈位移。
causeEn: There was no procedure of declaration between Maya city-states, and the causes of a star war are normally written on two layers, ritual and political. The first is time: the day had to be defensible in both the calendar and the stars, and a period-ending date such as 9.12.0.0.0 meant that whoever completed the rite first had, in the order of time itself, taken the upper hand - a legitimacy that could be displayed in the open between city-states. The second is circumstance: Palenque, tucked into the south-western corner, had to survive in the gap between the two great powers Tikal and Calakmul, and the communications, water and trading nodes of the Usumacinta valley had to be held by force, with allies and vassals needing a successful star war to confirm the order of things; the opponent was most likely a smaller polity of the region, attempting to challenge Palenque's authority or to seize resources on its margins while Palenque's main force was away. The sources are thin, and the enemy's name, the precise ground of dispute and the spark are all lost; what can be established is that this was a civic duel driven by dynastic authority and ritual obligation and timed by astronomical calendrics, not something that can be reduced to a private quarrel. In the same year Tikal and Dos Pilas were also striking at each other along the same lowland front, a reminder that the whole region's balance of power was shifting violently at that moment.
impact: 星戰的成敗在瑪雅世界不是一場勝負，而是一次政權性質的轉換：勝方往往扶植新王朝、取得宗主權，或讓被壓制的舊王朝復國；敗方則常見停擺立碑、人口流失、君主被虐殺，甚至整座城邦從此在銘文裡消失。對帕倫基而言，這場星勝的直接後果是它把 9.12.0.0.0 這個時期終結日綁進了自己的王室祭祀記錄；帕倫基宮殿碑版（立於683年，即巴卡爾去世之年）所記載的時期終結儀式，正是圍繞 9.12.0.0.0 這個節點展開，等於對外宣告這一段時間屬於帕倫基的王室譜系。對低地整體，星戰把天文曆算變成了政治工具：能算出金星相位與時期終結日的城邦，就能把自己的出征說成神意，卻也同時給了對手同樣的宣戰理由——這正是672年前後蒂卡爾、多斯皮拉斯、納蘭霍一線連環開戰的背景。長期看，強勢的代價同樣真實：帕倫基這一場得手並未換來長久太平，711年托尼納在星戰中擊敗帕倫基，這個王朝的城邦網絡從此受挫；同一機制在別處也一再出現，蒂卡爾因562年的一敗停擺了約120年，之後才由復國的聲勢重新崛起。
impactEn: In the Maya world the outcome of a star war was not a score but a change in the nature of power: the victor typically installed a new dynasty, took over the suzerainty, or restored a suppressed house to its throne; the defeated side often stopped erecting monuments, lost population, saw its ruler tortured to death, or vanished from the inscriptions altogether. For Palenque the direct consequence of this victory was that it tied the period-ending date 9.12.0.0.0 into its own royal ritual record: the palace tablet of Palenque, set up in 683, the year Pakal died, describes the period-ending ceremony built around the node 9.12.0.0.0, effectively declaring to the outside world that this stretch of time belonged to the Palenque dynasty. For the lowlands as a whole, the star war turned astronomical calendrics into a political instrument: a city-state able to compute the phase of Venus and the period-ending node could present its own campaign as divine will, while handing the same argument to its enemy - which is precisely the background to the chain of wars fought in the Tikal, Dos Pilas and Naranjo line around 672. In the long run the same mechanism bit the strong as well: Palenque's gain brought no lasting peace, and in 711 Tonina defeated Palenque in a star war, badly denting the dynasty's network; the same pattern recurs elsewhere, with Tikal halting for some 120 years after its defeat in 562 before its restoration took hold.
result: 結果很簡單：帕倫基勝，敵方政權敗。這是帕倫基唯一留下星戰銘文的記錄，日期鎖定在公元672年6月29日（9.12.0.0.0），敵方政權的名字則在殘存的銘文裡完全缺失，因此它的城名、位置與下場至今無人能確定。從帕倫基一側看，這場勝利讓王朝得以延續，並把這一段時期終結日的所有權力歸給王室；巴卡爾本人活到683年，繼承者接掌的局面也未因這一戰而崩解，只是到了711年，帕倫基仍被托尼納的星戰擊敗，說明這類優勢在瑪雅城邦體系裡從來不保險。放到672年這個更廣的時間點上，同一年的低地並不只有帕倫基在動武：670年多斯皮拉斯擊敗蒂卡爾，672年12月9日（9.12.0.8.3）蒂卡爾以第七次星戰奪回多斯皮拉斯，677年拉科羅納又在星戰中擊敗蒂卡爾，680年納蘭霍反過來擊敗卡拉克穆爾。星際大戰的編號就是這樣一段不斷易手的年代史，而第六次的那一天，只屬於帕倫基。
resultEn: The result is simple: Palenque won and the unnamed polity lost. This is the only star war for which Palenque has left an inscription, and the date is fixed at 29 June 672 (9.12.0.0.0); the name of the defeated polity is entirely absent from what survives, so its city, its position and its fate remain undetermined. From Palenque's side, the victory allowed the dynasty to continue and assigned the ownership of that period-ending date to the crown; Pakal himself lived until 683, and the succession he left behind did not collapse in the aftermath of the fighting, though in 711 Palenque was beaten by Tonina in a star war, which shows how little such an advantage was worth in the Maya city-state system. Placed in the broader year 672, Palenque was not the only power at war: Dos Pilas had defeated Tikal in 670, Tikal retook Dos Pilas on 9 December 672 (9.12.0.8.3) in the seventh star war, La Corona defeated Tikal in a star war in 677, and Naranjo in turn defeated Caracol in 680. The numbering of the star wars is thus the chronicle of a stretch of years in which hands changed repeatedly, and the sixth of them belonged to Palenque.
